title: MMU-07 auger hose keeps cracking
description: The auger swivel hose on MMU-07 has split three times since August. Each time it fails at the elbow. Find out why and fix it properly.
comments: Hose split again at the elbow. Replaced it with the same part (HX-2210). Noticed shiny wear marks on the boom clamp.

Found it: with the auger slewed fully left, the hose rubs on the boom clamp. Moved the clamp 40 mm towards the cab and added a protective sleeve (part SL-75). Pressure tested at 12 bar for 5 min, no leak.
Two weeks later, no new wear. MMU-03 and MMU-05 have the same clamp position, so check them at their next PM.
